trigger: Use when deciding where a document goes in a repository: adding, moving or naming a page or decision record, even when the request only asks to save a plan, a review or a note.

includes: which folder a document goes in, and its front matter
what stays out of the repository and off a public site
excludes: how the text of a page is written
a product's own site build and its commands
agent instruction files, changelogs and capsule content
